findings.what: The brief's binding TDD-seam list (§4 item 12) calls for extending interview-walk.spec.ts with a focus-return/Back-stability arm AND the UI-21 altitude leg (type an answer in the rail, follow ContinueOnboardingCard's link, prove the draft survives, focus lands in the thread, Back returns to Home, at 320px/200%). This file was never touched by the branch.
findings.evidence: `git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only` in the worktree lists no `interview-walk.spec.ts` entry at all. Independently confirmed the worker's stated reason: `which docker postgrest` finds neither on the Windows PATH, and `docs/plan/active/refresh-wave-2026-09-15/RIG.md`'s 'Running tests' section for web e2e never mentions the live-stack/docker/PostgREST runner that `apps/web/e2e/live-stack/run-live-walk.mjs` requires to populate `CLARA_E2E_INTERVIEW_*_CLIENT_ID/THREAD_ID`, which `interview-walk.spec.ts` hard-requires via `fixture()`. The final report's historical-row table marks UI-21 'NOT re-measured — named residual' rather than claiming it fixed or verified.
findings.fix: Either (a) have the orchestrator formally ratify UI-21 as an accepted named residual for this wave (the rig genuinely lacks docker/PostgREST for every one of the twelve worker worktrees per RIG.md, not just this one) and track the filed follow-up, or (b) require the arm's test code to be added to interview-walk.spec.ts UNEXECUTED, consistent with that file's own header convention ('that run happens in the review/merge ceremony, not during authorship'), so the assertion exists on the branch even though it cannot run pre-merge.

findings.what: The final report's AC6 line claims '2 axe scans' in the new Playwright walk; the file actually calls `scan()` three times.
findings.evidence: `grep -n "await scan(" apps/web/e2e/client-create-walk.spec.ts` returns three hits (lines 111, 151, 184), one per test (refused candidate face, arity-1 candidate face, 320px candidate face). Re-ran the spec (`npx playwright test e2e/client-create-walk.spec.ts`): 4 passed, all three scans included.
findings.fix: Correct the report line to '3 axe scans' for an exact evidence citation.

findings.where: packages/db/migrations/0204_client_onboarding_facts.sql:404-408 vs brief-649.md lines 51 and 74 ('candidate ids in detail')
findings.what: The brief's binding text says the ≥2 refusal carries 'candidate ids in detail'; the shipped migration (post commit ddff3d01) carries full candidate rows (id, name, party_kind, status, client_id, match_reason) instead of bare ids.
findings.evidence: 0204_client_onboarding_facts.sql:404-408's `detail := jsonb_build_object(..., 'candidates', v_rows)` where `v_rows` is the same jsonb array the arity-0/1 success path returns. Openly declared as 'Assumption 1' in the final report with reasoning (bare ids would force the refused face to print raw uuids or issue a second read of the same fact); DB battery cell `p649.identity.wall_two` (re-run, passing) asserts the richer row shape, not just ids.
findings.fix: Orchestrator should explicitly ratify Assumption 1 in the review response (or amend brief-649.md's wording to match the shipped, better-reasoned shape) so it does not stand as an un-ratified deviation from binding text.
